messages.subject: Brightwater v Caldervale — Particulars (my mark-up)
messages.plaintextBody:
Tom,

Here is the Particulars with my tracked changes. The two substantive additions are the Schedule 4 exclusion sentence (maintenance windows + customer network/SSO, and the 14 June outage) and the specific interest rate (4% over base). Otherwise content as drafted. Happy for this to be served once Nadia has approved the statement of truth.

Harriet
